meta.description: Golden charts for the 玄天排盘-compatible 奇门遁甲 app. R* = transcribed from reference screenshots; D* = computed with the spec's default rules (unconfirmed).

settings.clock: input is Beijing wall-clock time (UTC+8), no DST or 真太阳时

meta.stemOrderInSlot: for two-stem slots, the 中5 stem comes first, then the 坤2 stem
meta.stagesOrder: per palace branch order: 1子 8寅丑 3卯 4辰巳 9午 2未申 7酉 6亥戌
meta.calendarLibrary: lunar_python 1.4.8 (same algorithm and output as lunar-typescript 1.8.6)

cases.note: 23:00 starts the next day: 日柱 甲申, 阴遁8局
Before 立冬 (17:52): still 霜降, 月柱 戊戌
After 立冬: 月柱 己亥, 阴遁9局
Before 立春 (09:46): 年柱 丙午, 大寒
